## Description

Upgrade AWEX from 0.8.2 to 0.9.0 in both the SGLang and vLLM manifests and regenerate both lockfiles, following the scope of #1621. No other package versions change. AWEX 0.9.0 declares `cloudpickle>=2.2`; the existing locked version already satisfies this requirement.

## Related Issue

N/A. Reference: #1621.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

Dependency maintenance; the template has no dependency-specific type.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):**

No incompatibility identified by the static checks below. GPU runtime compatibility remains unverified.

## Additional Context

Validation:

- `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://pypi.org/simple bash scripts/uv_lock.sh`
- `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://pypi.org/simple pre-commit run --all-files` (passed in an isolated clone with the repository virtualenv)
- `git diff --check`
- Parsed both lockfiles and confirmed that AWEX is the only package whose version changed.
- Compared the 0.8.2 and 0.9.0 wheel sources across 22 imported AWEX modules; no missing modules or signature changes found among directly referenced definitions. Verified downloaded wheel hashes against PyPI metadata.

GPU/NCCL multi-process weight-transfer integration tests were not run because the local macOS environment lacks CUDA hardware. This static validation does not establish distributed runtime correctness.
